strings.accessibility_permission_desc1: This app uses this API to automate the clear-cache operation. The service temporarily accesses window content, including interactive windows, to locate specific buttons in the system settings and may perform automated gestures such as clicks or scrolling to complete the process.
strings.accessibility_permission_desc1_stop: This app uses this API to automate the force-stop operation. The service temporarily accesses window content, including interactive windows, to locate specific buttons in the system settings and may perform automated gestures such as clicks or scrolling to complete the process.
strings.accessibility_permission_desc2: Data accessed through this API will never be collected or shared.
strings.permission_success_desc1: Congratulations, you are ready to go.
strings.permission_success_desc2: We don't collect any of your personal or personally identifiable information.
strings.usage_access_permission_desc1: This app requires the Usage Data Access permission to detect the size of app, data and cache of the installed apps.
strings.usage_access_permission_desc2: To enable it, click the button below and allow permission for Apex.

strings.onboarding_page3_desc: Everything was successfully configured and now the app is ready to work. Have a nice use.

strings.welcome_desc: Your smart tool to free up storage and boost performance. Clear cached files and stop resource-hungry apps with a single tap.
